REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MEMBERS OF THE COUNCIL/AGENCY MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVE OR VIA TELECONFERENCE IN COMPLIANCE WITH STATE OF CA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 893 5320 8874
* THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER REMAINS CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC *
INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THE MEETING VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS,
MEETING ID # 893 5320 8874, ARE LISTED BELOW
THURSDAY - NOVEMBER 12, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber remains closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer order the Cerritos Council/Agency may be participating in this meeting from the City Council Chamber and/or authorized teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will continue through the methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the Council/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the Zoom meeting described below.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the Council/Agency.. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment, we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89353208874
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 893 5320 8874
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2020, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL
CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20,
VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 893 5320 8874

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to excuse Council/Agency Member
  Barrows from the meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Proclamations were made by the City Council as follows:

  David Conant, Norm Reeves Honda Superstore President (Nominee - 2021 TIME Dealer of
  the Year).

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Mark Steres, City Attorney, provided the following report from the October 22, 2020
  City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Closed Session:

  The City Council met in Closed Session to discuss Items 12A, 12B, and 12D as listed on
  the October 22, 2020 agenda:

  12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney
 City of Cerritos  November 12, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 7

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT (continued)

  12D.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) (COUNCIL)
  Number of cases: One (1)

  No reportable action was taken with regard to Items 12A and 12B. With regard to Item
  12D, the City Council discussed possible litigation regarding the West Santa Ana Branch
  Transit Project and authorized the hiring of an attorney to conduct a legal analysis
  regarding possible litigation.

  This concluded the City Attorney’s Closed Session report from the October 22, 2020
  City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Sam Desai expressed concerns about the ongoing impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
  and commented on a new local community newspaper, “Cerritos Newspaper.”

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of November
  12, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The title for this agenda item was incorrectly listed as requesting approval of the
  “November 12, 2020” meeting minutes rather than requesting approval of the “October
  22, 2020” meeting minutes. The October 22, 2020 meeting minutes will be placed on
  the November 23, 2020 meeting agenda for approval by the City Council.

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 12, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of Demands,
  as follows:

  City of Cerritos  11/12/2020  $ 9,518,150.05 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 12, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.2. Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated November 12, 2020 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of Demands,
  as follows:

  Successor Agency  11/12/2020  $ 12,750,149.75 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of Treasurer’s Reports

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending
  September 30, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION:  It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending September 30, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Adoption of Ordinance

  Ordinance introduced at the regular meeting of October 22, 2020

  Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1035, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, GRANTING TO GOLDEN STATE WATER COMPANY,
  A CALIFORNIA CORPORATION, A FRANCHISE FOR THE RIGHT TO USE OR TO LAY AND
  USE PIPES, CONDUITS, AND APPURTENANCES FOR TRANSMITTING AND DISTRIBUTING
  WATER IN, ALONG, ACROSS, UPON, AND UNDER THE PUBLIC STREETS, WAYS, ALLEYS
  AND PLACES WITHIN THE CITY OF CERRITOS (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and adopt
  Ordinance No. 1035, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS, GRANTING TO GOLDEN STATE WATER COMPANY, A CALIFORNIA
  CORPORATION, A FRANCHISE FOR THE RIGHT TO USE OR TO LAY AND USE
  PIPES, CONDUITS, AND APPURTENANCES FOR TRANSMITTING AND
  DISTRIBUTING WATER IN, ALONG, ACROSS, UPON, AND UNDER THE PUBLIC
  STREETS, WAYS, ALLEYS AND PLACES WITHIN THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 12, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 7

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to place a report on the next meeting
  agenda regarding residential parking permits for residents who can provide proof their
  college students are attending college virtually from their home.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration of a request by Sheraton Cerritos Hotel for the City of
  Cerritos to defer ground lease rent payments for a period of six (6) months, October
  2020 through March 2021, due to the adverse financial implications presented by the
  COVID-19 pandemic (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning/Economic Development
  Manager. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to authorize the Mayor or his
  designee to execute Rent Deferral Agreement #2 between the City of Cerritos and Crown
  Jewel of Pacifica, LLC and any related documentation to defer ground lease rent
  pursuant to the following rent deferral terms, in such form approved by the City
  Manager and the City Attorney:

  1. Rent Deferral Term: A period not to exceed six (6) consecutive months – October
  1, 2020 through March 31, 2021
  2. Total Rent Deferred: Approximately $68,973.28
   October – December 2020, $33,645.50
   January – March 2021 (CPI Increase TBD): Estimated $35,327.78
  3. Payback Terms:
   Payback to begin six (6) months after the deferral end date (October 1,
  2021)
   Payback shall be within a period of twelve (12) months and/or no later
  than October 1, 2022, interest free
   Payments can be made monthly along with regularly scheduled ground
  rent payments, in one lump-sum, or a combination of both
   Penalty for non-payment: If full payment is not received by October 1,
  2022, payment shall be required with the addition of 15% interest on the
  outstanding balance
  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  November 12, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos City Council
  regarding the repair of the 16-inch reclaimed water main line at the intersection of
  Norwalk Boulevard and 166th Street (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Approve the appropriation and expenditure of funds in the amount of $247,640.53
  from the Reclaimed Water Fund for the repair of the reclaimed water main break;
  and

  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING THE CERRITOS ELECTRIC
  UTILITY RENEWABLE ENERGY RESOURCES PROCUREMENT PLAN, COMPLIANCE PERIOD
  3 (2017-2020) PURSUANT TO PUBLIC UTILITIES CODE § 399.30(A) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ramzi Raufdeen, Electric Utility Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and adopt
  Resolution No. 2020-30, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING THE CERRITOS ELECTRIC UTILITY
  RENEWABLE ENERGY RESOURCES PROCUREMENT PLAN, COMPLIANCE PERIOD
  3 (2017-2020) PURSUANT TO PUBLIC UTILITIES CODE § 399.30(A) (COUNCIL).

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, RESTRICTING AND/OR PROHIBITING
  THE PARKING OF MOTOR VEHICLES ON PORTIONS OF DUMONT AVENUE WITHIN THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and adopt
  Resolution No. 2020-31, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF

  NOES:  None

  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  There were no reports made by members of the City Council.

  CONSENSUS (Solanki): Directed the City Manager to prepare a report regarding
